class.name: OcgBrepmeshVertextool
class.brief_description: Describes data structure intended to keep mesh nodes defined in UV space and implements functionality providing their uniqueness regarding their position.
class.description: ! Describes data structure intended to keep mesh nodes ! defined in UV space and implements functionality ! providing their uniqueness regarding their position.

method.name: SetCellSize_1
method.description: Sets new size of cell for cellfilter equal in both directions.

method.name: SetCellSize_2
method.description: Sets new size of cell for cellfilter.

method.name: SetTolerance_1
method.description: Sets the tolerance to be used for identification of coincident vertices equal for both dimensions.

method.name: SetTolerance_2
method.description: Sets the tolerance to be used for identification of coincident vertices.

method.name: GetTolerance
method.description: Gets the tolerance to be used for identification of coincident vertices.

method.name: Add
method.description: Adds vertex with empty data to the tool.

method.name: DeleteVertex
method.description: Deletes vertex with the given index from the tool.

method.name: FindKey
method.description: Returns vertex by the given index.

method.name: FindIndex
method.description: Returns index of the given vertex.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Returns True when the map contains no keys.

method.name: Substitute
method.description: Substitutes vertex with the given by the given vertex with attributes.

method.name: RemoveLast
method.description: Remove last node from the structure.
